name: caption
description: Auto-captioning with LLMs/JoyCaption and ComfyUI custom workflow nodes, with the Gallery browser built in. Captioning GGUF models can be downloaded from HuggingFace via the Caption Models settings page.
author: DeeplabSystems

volumes.description: ComfyUI installation folder. In Docker mode this folder must contain main.py so the Caption Models page can install nodes into custom_nodes.
Directory for captioning models (GGUF + mmproj). Point this at your LM Studio models folder to reuse existing GGUFs — files downloaded from the Caption Models page land here too
Media root this plugin captions. The studio reads it from here — there is no folder bar.

assistant_actions.name: batch_status
assistant_actions.description: Caption batch state, progress and recent events.
